name: Czech Pipe Tool (3-in-1)
description: The Czech pipe tool is one of those objects so well-conceived that it has remained essentially unchanged for a century. Three tools in one folding implement: a tamper, a pick for clearing the draught hole, and a spatula for removing dottle. Fits in any pocket. Loses itself in any drawer. Buy three.

name: Rattray's Tobacco Pouch — Black Leather
description: A two-fold tobacco pouch in smooth black leather, lined with a moisture-resistant interior that keeps your tobacco at the correct humidity for field smoking. Holds approximately 1.5oz. The magnetic closure is quiet and secure. Rattray's have been making pipe accessories in Scotland since 1903 — they understand what a pipe smoker actually needs.

name: Savinelli Balsa Pipe Filters 9mm (50-pack)
description: Savinelli's balsa wood filters absorb moisture without affecting tobacco flavour — a meaningful improvement over paper or charcoal alternatives. These 9mm filters fit the majority of Savinelli pipes and most European pipes built to the 9mm standard. Fifty filters to a box. Change after every two or three smokes for best results.

name: Brigham Pipe Cleaners — Regular (132-pack)
description: Brigham's regular pipe cleaners are the benchmark of the category — absorbent, stiff enough to navigate a bent stem, and consistent in diameter. At 132 per bundle they represent genuine value. A pipe smoker who cleans properly will go through two or three per smoke; buy in bulk and stop thinking about it.

name: Peterson Deluxe 6-Pipe Stand
description: A six-pipe rotating stand in lacquered wood with individual rest cups lined in soft felt. The rotating base allows access to any pipe without disturbing the others — a small but genuine convenience when your morning routine involves choosing rather than grabbing. Peterson's hardware and joinery are to a standard that will outlast the pipes it holds.

name: Tamper — Sterling Silver Acorn
description: Cast in sterling silver, finished by hand, the acorn tamper is the object you reach for fifty times a day and never tire of. The weight of the silver gives a pleasing resistance when pressing down through a bowl. The acorn form, used by tobacconists since the eighteenth century, fits naturally between thumb and forefinger. A tamper worth keeping for a lifetime.

name: Obsidian Oil Pipe Stem Treatment (2oz)
description: Obsidian Oil is the standard treatment for oxidised vulcanite stems — apply a few drops to a cloth, buff the stem, and the grey bloom disappears in minutes. Regular use prevents oxidation from forming in the first place. Safe on all stem materials including acrylic and Cumberland. A bottle lasts years.

name: Vauen Pipe Reamer — Universal Adjustable
description: An adjustable reamer that expands to fit bowl diameters from 14mm to 22mm — covering the vast majority of briar and meerschaum pipes in production. The steel blades remove excess cake evenly without gouging the wood. Vauen have been making pipe accessories in Germany since 1848; the quality is exactly what you would expect.
